# MX Division Builds reference

The local Build Tool behavior was reviewed against the supplied `mx-division-builds-master.zip`
archive (MX Division Builds). The archive declares **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**. This project does
not copy its JavaScript bundles, Vue components, or icon assets; it implements a native
Tkinter adaptation using the existing local game library. Any future copied asset must
retain this attribution, identify modifications, and remain compatible with the
non-commercial ShareAlike terms.

Reference: https://github.com/mxswat/mx-division-builds
